description: Find the start times that are open for one visit (a service from the card whose bookable is true), between two dates (at most 14 days). Each time's end includes the minutes the business takes to settle the dog in. Pass `windows` (the customer's free time from their calendar) to get only the starts that fit both calendars. Returns ISO 8601 times with offsets. Only open times are ever shown.

inputSchema.description: Ask for the start times that are open for one visit. Only the business's own open times come back, narrowed to the customer's free windows when given.

from.description: First day, YYYY-MM-DD, in the business's time zone (the card names it). Not in the past.

items.description: Exactly one visit. Each visit is booked on its own; add-ons the service takes go in answers.addons.
The visit being booked: the `slug` of a service from the business card whose `bookable` is true.

quantity.description: 1, or left out: one visit, however many dogs (they go in answers.dogs).

slug.description: The service's slug, from the card's services list.

to.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD. At most 14 days from `from`, counting both, and at most 60 days from today.

windows.description: The customer's free time, as intervals with offsets. When given, only starts whose whole visit (its length plus its settling time) fits inside one window come back. Leave out to see every open start.

items.description: A stretch of time the customer is free, from their own calendar. Both ends are ISO 8601 with an offset ("2026-10-12T09:00:00-07:00" or "...Z"), and the end is after the start. Written either as {start, end} or as one ISO 8601 interval string "start/end".

name: find_times
title: Find open times
